title: VPC change scenario notebook and sample evidence playground
content:
Context and motivation:
This is a working notebook for designing a lightweight, developer-friendly evidence format and test harness for VPC change operations in customer-managed networking. Many PRDs focus on gating language or retention policy; this doc is intentionally practical: capture example events, the minimum proof bundle to surface in the Console, and how to run synthetic scenarios that validate auditing and rollback UX.

Goals:
- Define a compact evidence capsule that customers and operators can attach to any VPC change (create/modify/delete). Capsules must be small enough for event stores and easy to index.
- Show how approval gates map to capsule fields and what is surfaced in the Console (operator + customer view).
- Establish a simulation plan for QA: synthetic traffic, conflicting changes, delayed agent heartbeats, and operator rollback tests.
- Draft acceptance criteria and sample queries for forensic investigations.

Non-goals:
- This is not a full retention/archival policy (separate PRD).
- We are not dictating a particular crypto library for signatures; we assume existing KMS/HSM integrations handle signing.

Key constraints / assumptions:
- Private deployments may have intermittent connectivity to the control plane during handoff windows; evidence capsules must be resilient to delayed uploads.
- Customers will want compact, human-readable fields plus an opaque signature blob for integrity.
- Console UI should avoid exposing raw payloads unless the investigator clicks into a ‘forensics view’.

Operators and personas:
- Customer Network Admin (CNA): submits change, can request expedited approval, and must provide justification. Needs a clear timeline and ability to attach rollback notes.
- Redwood Operator: reviews evidence and may trigger a canary with limited scope. Needs quick indicators (risk score, missing evidence).
- SRE on customer side: may run local validation scripts and needs consistent field names for automation.

Suggested approval gate types (mapped to capsule usage):
- Pre-approval (automated policy check): capsule must include policy_version and policy_result.
- Human approval required: capsule includes approver_id, approval_window, and escalation_path.
- Emergency override: capsule includes override_reason, stubbed_justification_attachment (link) and audit_marker for post-hoc review.

Evidence capsule design (compact, single-line JSON-friendly fields):
- event_id: stable unique id for the change (uuid v4)
- timestamp_utc: ISO8601
- actor: short string (org:user or system)
- op_type: create|update|delete|rollback|approve|escalate
- target: resource short id (vpc-xxxx or subnet-xxx)
- delta_summary: plain text 1-2 lines describing config diff or attach a small delta blob if needed
- policy_version: semantic version of policy used to gate (optional)
- approval: one of automated|pending|approved|rejected|overridden
- approver_id: the human approver (if approval != automated)
- approval_window: start/end timestamps (string)
- evidence_links: array of short URLs (console artifact ids; we store index refs)
- snapshot_hash: sha256 of the infra snapshot after change (string)
- upload_status: queued|uploaded|failed|attached_local_only
- signature: base64 of signature over the canonicalized capsule (opaque)
- provenance_tags: small csv string for quick filters (e.g. "canary,network-team")

NOTE: The doc store wants top-level flat fields for indexing; nested objects increase query cost. The above remains flat and small.

Sample evidence capsule (text blob to be stored as a single JSON string in the event row):

{"event_id":"c5e3b2f2-8a6d-4b4a-9c3e-1f2b8d9a4e3c","timestamp_utc":"2025-01-18T14:22:08Z","actor":"org:customer-alice","op_type":"update","target":"vpc-03b2f9","delta_summary":"changed egress CIDR from 0.0.0.0/0 to 10.0.0.0/16 for service-boundary","policy_version":"1.4.2","approval":"approved","approver_id":"alice.network-admin@custco.com","approval_window":"2025-01-18T14:00:00Z/2025-01-18T14:30:00Z","evidence_links":"console-artifact:evt-7892","snapshot_hash":"sha256:af12b3...","upload_status":"uploaded","signature":"MEUCIQDb...base64...","provenance_tags":"canary,limited-burst"}

(we keep the signature opaque; Console will verify validation via control-plane KMS before showing integrity badge)

Forensic sampling and traces:
- Lightweight sampling: store every Nth event (configurable) plus all events labeled override or emergency.
- Time-based windows: persist full capsules for any event that occurs within 30m of an approved emergency override.
- Trace linking: each capsule should include a trace_id (if present) to correlate with request-level traces collected by SRE.

Simulation / QA harness (not exhaustive):
1) Synthetic scenario: simultaneous updates to overlapping subnets across two agents. Validate: conflict detection, capsule creation for both agents, and automatic escalator triggers.
2) Delayed upload: simulate agent network outage for 24h, ensure capsule persists locally, status=attached_local_only, then verify eventual reconciliation and signature verification.
3) Canary rollback: apply change to canary subnet, then trigger canary alert -> automatic rollback. Validate capsule sequence: update -> canary-alert -> rollback with linked_snapshot hashes.
4) Approver churn: approver user removed from IdP mid-window, simulate approval attempt and ensure approval_id is retained as historical string and a new approver is captured for re-approval flow.

Console UI notes (operator vs customer):
- List view: row per event with event_id, target, op_type, timestamp, approval status, preview of delta_summary, risk score color band.
- Drill-in forensic view: show the full capsule, evidence_links, snapshot diff rendered, and signature validation badge with KMS key id and validation timestamp.
- Quick actions: cancel pending change, escalate (email + webhooks), initiate rollback with one-click that circulates a new capsule of op_type=rollback.

Acceptance criteria (for beta):
- Capsules created for 100% of VPC changes in private deployment e2e test environment.
- Signature verification shows success for 99.5% of uploaded capsules in CI runs.
- Console shows rollbacks initiated from operator UI and each rollback produces a linked capsule with snapshot_hash that matches the pre-change snapshot.

Open questions (short list):
- Do we want to surface approver metadata (emails) in the default list view or behind the drill-in? Tradeoff: noise vs quick context.
- What TTL for local-attached-only capsules before we escalate or fail the change? Current thought: 7 days with exponential retry.
- How many evidence_links should we allow in a capsule before we force a referenced bundle id?

Immediate next steps / TODOs:
- (Jonas) stub an example ingestion pipeline that accepts capsule string and stores as event_row. RDW-1427 assigned.
- (Maya) wireframe the Console list + forensic drill view; show signature badge.
- (Riley) create the small qa harness scripts for the 4 simulation cases above and add to infra/test/approval-sims.

Notes to self / rough ideas to revisit:
- Consider an optional compact binary signature envelope for very light-weight IoT-style agents in on-prem customers.
- Think about a compact human-readable change summary language to improve triage speed ("change intent: reduce public egress").
- Keep capsule fields stable (append-only) for indexing backwards compatibility.

Appendix: sample quick CLI check that an event is fully uploaded (rough):
- GET /events/{event_id} -> returns capsule string, upload_status=uploaded, signature_verified=true, snapshot_hash present
- GET /snapshots/{snapshot_hash} -> returns small manifest used by rollback

End of notebook. This is a living working doc; expect to pick up design decisions after the first alpha test with two enterprise customers.
